title: Delivery
description: A Delivery, as stored in `beta-3-g<N>-deliveries` for `POST /deliveries`, or the empty one `POST /receipts` creates for an undocumented Receipt.

_id.description: Generated: a Delivery ID isn't unique, as a resubmitted hazardous Movement has a Delivery per submission, each with its Movement ID as their Delivery ID.

payload.description: The `POST /deliveries` request body, as sent, shared by every Delivery it recorded. Not present on an undocumented Receipt's Delivery, whose request is kept with its Receipt.

deliveryId.description: The Delivery ID: minted for the non-hazardous Movements' Delivery and an undocumented Receipt's, or a hazardous Movement's own Movement ID.

movementIds.description: The Movements delivered. Empty for an undocumented Receipt's Delivery.

wasteType.description: Whether the Movements delivered are hazardous. Not present on an undocumented Receipt's Delivery.
